blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Which of the following differential equations are separable and which of them are homogeneous? \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = 1 + y\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh classification (darja bandi) ka sawal hai: humein equation solve nahi karni, sirf us ki qisam batani hai.
Diya kya hai? \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = 1 + y\).
Plan: \(x\) se divide kar ke \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela karenge.
Phir do test: kya right side \(g(x)h(y)\) zarb hai? Kya woh sirf \(\frac{y}{x}\) se likhi ja sakti hai?
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = 1 + y\).
Maloom karna: separable hai ya homogeneous.
Tareeqa: Equation ko \(\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)\) ki shakal mein likhenge. Agar \(f\) ko (sirf \(x\) ka function) \(\times\) (sirf \(y\) ka function) mein tora ja sake to separable. Agar \(f\) ko sirf ratio \(\frac{y}{x}\) ki madad se likha ja sake to homogeneous. Dono test baari baari lagayenge. Yaad rakhiye: koi equation dono qisam ki bhi ho sakti hai aur kisi bhi qisam ki nahi bhi; is liye ek test pass hone ke baad bhi doosra test zaroor dekhiye taake jawab mukammal ho.

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela likhein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{1 + y}{x}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{x} \cdot (1 + y)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(x\) se divide kiya (\(x \ne 0\)). Ab right side ko saaf dekh sakte hain.

Separable test
\[g(x) = \dfrac{1}{x}, \quad h(y) = 1 + y\]
Kyun: Right side ek sirf-\(x\) function aur ek sirf-\(y\) function ka zarb hai. Is liye equation separable hai: \(\frac{dy}{1 + y} = \frac{dx}{x}\) likh kar integrate kar sakte hain.
Dhyan dein: \(1 + y\) mein jama hai, lekin us mein sirf \(y\) hai, is liye yeh poora ka poora \(h(y)\) ban sakta hai. Masla tab hota hai jab jama mein \(x\) aur \(y\) dono hon.

Homogeneous test
\[\dfrac{1 + y}{x} = \dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{y}{x}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{y}{x}\) wala hissa to theek hai, lekin \(\frac{1}{x}\) ko sirf \(\frac{y}{x}\) se nahi likh sakte. Wajah: 1 ki degree 0 hai aur \(y\) ki degree 1; degrees barabar nahi. Is liye homogeneous nahi.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Which of the following differential equations are separable and which of them are homogeneous? \(x^2(2y + 1)\,dy - dx = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir se sirf qisam batani hai.
Diya kya hai? Differential form \(x^2(2y + 1)\,dy - dx = 0\).
Plan: \(dx\) ko doosri taraf bhej kar \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nikalenge.
Phir right side par separable aur homogeneous dono test lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^2(2y + 1)\,dy - dx = 0\).
Maloom karna: separable hai ya homogeneous.
Tareeqa: Equation ko \(\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)\) ki shakal mein likhenge. Agar \(f\) ko (sirf \(x\) ka function) \(\times\) (sirf \(y\) ka function) mein tora ja sake to separable. Agar \(f\) ko sirf ratio \(\frac{y}{x}\) ki madad se likha ja sake to homogeneous. Dono test baari baari lagayenge. Yaad rakhiye: koi equation dono qisam ki bhi ho sakti hai aur kisi bhi qisam ki nahi bhi; is liye ek test pass hone ke baad bhi doosra test zaroor dekhiye taake jawab mukammal ho.

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela likhein
\[x^2(2y + 1)\,dy = dx\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{1}{x^2(2y + 1)}\]
Kyun: \(-dx\) ko right par bheja to \(+dx\) ban gaya. Phir dono taraf \(x^2(2y + 1)\,dx\) se divide kiya.

Separable test
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{1}{x^2} \cdot \dfrac{1}{2y + 1}\]
Kyun: Ek sirf-\(x\) function aur ek sirf-\(y\) function ka zarb, is liye separable: \((2y + 1)\,dy = \frac{dx}{x^2}\). Yeh wahi equation hai jo 4.2.1 ki Example 6 mein solve hui thi.

Homogeneous test
Denominator \(2x^2y + x^2\) mein \(2x^2y\) ki degree 3 aur \(x^2\) ki degree 2 hai.
Kyun: Degrees barabar nahi, is liye \(y = vx\) rakhne par \(x\) poori tarah cancel nahi hoga. Homogeneous nahi.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Which of the following differential equations are separable and which of them are homogeneous? \((2xy + x^2)\,dy - y^2\,dx = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Sirf qisam batani hai.
Diya kya hai? \((2xy + x^2)\,dy - y^2\,dx = 0\).
Plan: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nikal kar har term ki degree ginenge.
Agar sab ki degree barabar ho to homogeneous ka shak; phir \(x^2\) se divide kar ke pakka karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \((2xy + x^2)\,dy - y^2\,dx = 0\).
Maloom karna: separable hai ya homogeneous.
Tareeqa: Equation ko \(\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)\) ki shakal mein likhenge. Agar \(f\) ko (sirf \(x\) ka function) \(\times\) (sirf \(y\) ka function) mein tora ja sake to separable. Agar \(f\) ko sirf ratio \(\frac{y}{x}\) ki madad se likha ja sake to homogeneous. Dono test baari baari lagayenge. Yaad rakhiye: koi equation dono qisam ki bhi ho sakti hai aur kisi bhi qisam ki nahi bhi; is liye ek test pass hone ke baad bhi doosra test zaroor dekhiye taake jawab mukammal ho.

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela likhein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{y^2}{2xy + x^2}\]
Kyun: \(-y^2\,dx\) ko right par bheja, phir \((2xy + x^2)\,dx\) se divide kiya.

Homogeneous test
\(y^2\), \(2xy\), \(x^2\): teeno ki degree 2 hai. Upar neeche \(x^2\) se divide karein:
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)^2}{2\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + 1}\]
\[= F\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{y^2}{x^2} = \left(\frac{y}{x}\right)^2\), \(\frac{2xy}{x^2} = 2\frac{y}{x}\), \(\frac{x^2}{x^2} = 1\). Ab right side mein sirf \(\frac{y}{x}\) hai, is liye homogeneous.

Separable test
\[\dfrac{y^2}{x(2y + x)}\]
Kyun: Bracket \(2y + x\) mein \(x\) aur \(y\) jama ki shakal mein jure hain. Jama ko zarb mein nahi tor sakte, is liye right side \(g(x)h(y)\) nahi ban sakti. Separable nahi.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Which of the following differential equations are separable and which of them are homogeneous? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x - y}\)
blocks.explanation:
Sirf qisam batani hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x - y}\).
Rule kaunsa? Exponents ka qanoon \(a^{m - n} = a^m a^{-n}\).
Plan: \(e^{x - y}\) ko do hisson mein torenge, phir dono test lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x - y}\).
Maloom karna: separable hai ya homogeneous.
Tareeqa: Equation ko \(\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)\) ki shakal mein likhenge. Agar \(f\) ko (sirf \(x\) ka function) \(\times\) (sirf \(y\) ka function) mein tora ja sake to separable. Agar \(f\) ko sirf ratio \(\frac{y}{x}\) ki madad se likha ja sake to homogeneous. Dono test baari baari lagayenge. Yaad rakhiye: koi equation dono qisam ki bhi ho sakti hai aur kisi bhi qisam ki nahi bhi; is liye ek test pass hone ke baad bhi doosra test zaroor dekhiye taake jawab mukammal ho.

Exponential ko torein
\[e^{x - y} = e^x \cdot e^{-y}\]
Kyun: Power mein minus ho to woh do powers ka zarb ban jata hai: \(a^{m - n} = a^m \cdot a^{-n}\).

Separable test
\[g(x) = e^x, \quad h(y) = e^{-y}\]
Kyun: Sirf-\(x\) aur sirf-\(y\) functions ka zarb mil gaya, is liye separable: \(e^y\,dy = e^x\,dx\).
Dhyan dein: Power mein \(x - y\) dekh kar ghabrayein nahi; exponential jama ya minus ko zarb mein badal deta hai.

Homogeneous test
\[x - y = x\left(1 - \dfrac{y}{x}\right)\]
Kyun: Ek \(x\) bahar bach jata hai jo cancel nahi hota, is liye \(e^{x - y}\) ko sirf \(\frac{y}{x}\) se nahi likh sakte. Homogeneous nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (us ka item 2, jo asal mein Question 1 ka jawab hai) (iv) ko "Homogeneous" mein likhti hai. Yeh ghalat hai: \(e^{x - y} = e^x \cdot e^{-y}\) ek zarb \(g(x)h(y)\) hai, is liye (iv) separable hai, homogeneous nahi.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Which of the following differential equations are separable and which of them are homogeneous? \(\frac{dT}{dt} + k(T - T_m) = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Sirf qisam batani hai, lekin is dafa letters badle hue hain.
Yahan \(t\) independent variable hai (jaise \(x\)) aur \(T\) dependent variable (jaise \(y\)); \(k\) aur \(T_m\) constants hain.
Plan: \(\frac{dT}{dt}\) akela karenge aur right side ko test karenge.
Yeh 4.1.1 wala Newton ka cooling law hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dT}{dt} + k(T - T_m) = 0\), \(k\) aur \(T_m\) constants.
Maloom karna: separable hai ya homogeneous.
Tareeqa: \(\frac{dT}{dt} = f(t, T)\) likhenge. Agar \(f\) (sirf \(t\)) \(\times\) (sirf \(T\)) ban jaye to separable; agar sirf \(\frac{T}{t}\) se likha ja sake to homogeneous.

\(\frac{dT}{dt}\) ko akela likhein
\[\dfrac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_m)\]
Kyun: \(k(T - T_m)\) ko right par bheja to minus lag gaya.

Separable test
\[\dfrac{dT}{T - T_m} = -k\,dt\]
Kyun: Right side (constant \(-k\), jo \(t\) ka constant function hai) \(\times\) (\(T - T_m\), jo sirf \(T\) ka function hai). Variables alag ho gaye, is liye separable.
Dhyan dein: Agar right side mein \(t\) bilkul na ho to bhi equation separable hoti hai; \(g(t)\) bas ek constant hai.

Homogeneous test
Kyun: \(T - T_m\) mein \(t\) hai hi nahi, aur constant \(T_m\) ki degree 0 jabke \(T\) ki degree 1 hai. Is ko \(\frac{T}{t}\) ke function ki shakal mein nahi likh sakte. Homogeneous nahi.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Which of the following differential equations are separable and which of them are homogeneous? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \ln(x) - \ln(y)\); \(x > 0,\ y > 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Sirf qisam batani hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \ln x - \ln y\), \(x, y > 0\).
Rule kaunsa? Log ka qanoon \(\ln a - \ln b = \ln\frac{a}{b}\).
Plan: do logs ko ek log banayenge, phir dekhenge ke kya sirf \(\frac{y}{x}\) bachta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \ln x - \ln y\), \(x > 0\), \(y > 0\).
Maloom karna: separable hai ya homogeneous.
Tareeqa: Equation ko \(\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)\) ki shakal mein likhenge. Agar \(f\) ko (sirf \(x\) ka function) \(\times\) (sirf \(y\) ka function) mein tora ja sake to separable. Agar \(f\) ko sirf ratio \(\frac{y}{x}\) ki madad se likha ja sake to homogeneous. Dono test baari baari lagayenge. Yaad rakhiye: koi equation dono qisam ki bhi ho sakti hai aur kisi bhi qisam ki nahi bhi; is liye ek test pass hone ke baad bhi doosra test zaroor dekhiye taake jawab mukammal ho.

Logs ko jorein
\[\ln x - \ln y = \ln\dfrac{x}{y}\]
\[= -\ln\dfrac{y}{x}\]
Kyun: Log ka quotient rule \(\ln a - \ln b = \ln\frac{a}{b}\). Aur \(\frac{x}{y}\) ulta \(\frac{y}{x}\) hai, is liye \(\ln\frac{x}{y} = -\ln\frac{y}{x}\).

Homogeneous test
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\ln\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right) = F\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right)\]
Kyun: Right side mein sirf \(\frac{y}{x}\) hai, is liye homogeneous. \(y = vx\) rakhein to \(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = -\ln v\) ban jata hai.

Separable test
Kyun: \(\ln x - \ln y\) ek sirf-\(x\) aur ek sirf-\(y\) function ka farq (minus) hai, zarb nahi. Separable ke liye zarb \(g(x)h(y)\) chahiye. Is liye separable nahi.
Dhyan dein: Part (iv) mein \(e^{x - y}\) zarb ban gaya tha, lekin log ke saath aisa nahi hota; log minus ko taqseem (division) mein badalta hai, zarb mein nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein likha hai "Separable: (i), (ii), (v), (vi)  Homogeneous: (iii), (iv), (vii)". Sawal mein sirf chhe parts hain, (vii) koi nahi, aur do parts ki qisam ulti likhi hai: (iv) separable hai aur (vi) homogeneous hai (\(\ln x - \ln y = -\ln\frac{y}{x}\)). Sahi jawab: separable (i), (ii), (iv), (v); homogeneous (iii), (vi).
